verdict.rationale: Attio's docs explicitly describe a flexible data model allowing custom objects and lists with a wide array of attribute types, plus linking objects together to model relationships beyond standard people/companies/deals (attio-docs-8, attio-docs-9, attio-docs-66, attio-docs-84, attio-docs-29). Custom fields/attributes are also confirmed (attio-docs-46). missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration outside Attio's own docs, and more detail on relationship/reference field types and limits.
